literal: By great wealth becoming that which is desired, and by rare ruin, yielding abundantly, is a country.
translation: A true country is one that is coveted by others for its immense wealth, yet remains free from devastating ruin, yielding food and resources in great abundance.
modern: மிகுந்த செல்வத்தால் பிற நாடுகள் விரும்பத்தக்கதாகி, எவ்வித அழிவும் இல்லாமல், மிக அதிகமாக விளைச்சலைத் தருவதே சிறந்த நாடாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential economic and physical qualities of a prosperous nation. First, it must possess great wealth so that it is highly valued and desired by others. Second, it must be free from devastating calamities, pests, or external destruction, ensuring safety. Finally, it must naturally yield agricultural and material produce in great abundance. Together, these elements of wealth, security, and high productivity constitute a true country.
